entities.name: Ijichi Kōsuke
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Baron Ijichi Kōsuke  was a general in the Imperial Japanese Army in the First Sino-Japanese War and Chief of Staff of the Japanese Third Army during the Siege of Port Arthur in the Russo-Japanese War. His wife was the niece of Marshal Oyama Iwao.
